scope: development fitting and adapter validation only; no held-out performance comparison
model: weighted standardized ridge regression on log expansion CPU
validation_groups: family plus width; all orderings/checkpoints of a structure remain together
selection_metric: mean across groups of mean absolute log prediction error
training_weights: equal structure weights, then equal states, then equal qualified candidates
freeze: choose alpha using development group validation; fit once on all qualified development rows; no tuning from policy validation timings
